```{r setup, include = FALSE}
for (p in c("_common.R", "../_common.R", "vignettes/_common.R"))
  if (file.exists(p)) { source(p); break }
```

These components arrange the rest. Like the overlays, they run client-side, so
the tabs switch, the accordion expands and the carousel slides right here. Those
with an `inputId` also report the active pane through `input$id`. See
[Layout & composition](layout.html) for putting them together into a full app
shell.

## Tabs

Switch between panes. The active value is `input$id`; drive it from the server
with `update_shad_tabs()`.

```{r}
demo(
  columns = TRUE,
  shad_tabs(
    "demo_tabs", selected = "account",
    shad_tab("account", "Account",
      tags$div(style = "padding-top:0.75rem",
        shad_p("Update your account details here."))),
    shad_tab("password", "Password",
      tags$div(style = "padding-top:0.75rem",
        shad_p("Change your password here."))),
    shad_tab("team", "Team", icon = "circle",
      tags$div(style = "padding-top:0.75rem",
        shad_p("Manage your team members.")))
  )
)
```

## Accordion

Vertically stacked, collapsible sections. `type = "single"` keeps one open;
`"multiple"` allows many.

```{r}
demo(
  columns = TRUE,
  shad_accordion(
    "demo_acc", type = "single", collapsible = TRUE, value = "a1",
    shad_accordion_item("a1", "Is it accessible?",
      shad_p("Yes. It follows the WAI-ARIA disclosure pattern.")),
    shad_accordion_item("a2", "Is it styled?",
      shad_p("Yes. It comes with sensible defaults you can theme.")),
    shad_accordion_item("a3", "Is it animated?",
      shad_p("Yes — height transitions come for free."))
  )
)
```

## Collapsible

A single show/hide region behind any trigger.

```{r}
demo(
  columns = TRUE,
  shad_collapsible(
    "demo_coll", open = FALSE,
    trigger = shad_button("Show advanced options", variant = "ghost",
      icon = "chevrons-up-down", icon_position = "right"),
    tags$div(style = "padding:0.75rem 0;display:grid;gap:0.5rem",
      shad_muted("These options are hidden until requested."),
      shad_switch("adv_a", label = "Enable experimental features"))
  )
)
```

## Pagination

Page controls that report the current page as `input$id`.

```{r}
demo(shad_pagination("demo_pg", pages = 8, selected = 3))
```

## Carousel

A horizontal slider with optional dots and arrows.

```{r}
demo(
  columns = TRUE,
  tags$div(
    style = "max-width:22rem;width:100%;margin:0 auto",
    do.call(shad_carousel, c(
      list("demo_car", show_dots = TRUE),
      lapply(1:4, function(i) shad_carousel_item(
        shad_card(shad_card_content(
          tags$div(style = "display:grid;place-items:center;height:8rem;font-size:2rem;font-weight:600", i)))))
    ))
  )
)
```

## Scroll area

A styled, fixed-height scroll container.

```{r}
demo(
  columns = TRUE,
  shad_scroll_area(
    height = "10rem",
    tags$div(style = "padding-right:1rem",
      shad_h4("Tags", style = "margin-top:0"),
      tagList(lapply(1:20, function(i) tagList(
        shad_p(paste("Item", i), style = "margin:0.35rem 0"),
        shad_separator()))))
  )
)
```

## Resizable

Draggable split panes. Drag the handle to resize.

```{r}
demo(
  columns = TRUE,
  tags$div(style = "height:12rem",
    shad_resizable(
      "demo_rz",
      shad_resizable_panel(default_size = 40,
        tags$div(style = "display:grid;place-items:center;height:100%", "Sidebar")),
      shad_resizable_handle(),
      shad_resizable_panel(default_size = 60,
        tags$div(style = "display:grid;place-items:center;height:100%", "Content"))
    )
  )
)
```

## Layout primitives

*A shadshiny addition: no shadcn/ui counterpart.*

`shad_container()`, `shad_stack()` and `shad_grid()` cover page layout without
hand-written CSS. Spacing takes a token step — `gap = 4` is
`var(--shad-space-4)`, the same scale the components use internally — or any CSS
length.

`shad_grid(min_width = )` fits as many equal columns as will fit, with no
breakpoints to maintain. **Resize the window** to watch this reflow:

```{r}
demo(
  columns = TRUE,
  shad_grid(
    shad_value_box("$45,231", "Revenue", delta = "+20.1%"),
    shad_value_box("2,350", "Subscribers", delta = "+180"),
    shad_value_box("573", "Active now"),
    min_width = "13rem"
  )
)
```

For an exact column count, pass `cols` — optionally per breakpoint
(`base`, `sm` 40rem, `md` 48rem, `lg` 64rem), where each falls back to the one
below it. `shad_grid_item(span = )` spans cells, and `template` takes a raw
track list:

```{r}
demo(
  columns = TRUE,
  shad_grid(
    shad_card(shad_card_content("1fr")),
    shad_card(shad_card_content("2fr")),
    shad_grid_item(shad_card(shad_card_content("full row")), span = "full"),
    template = "1fr 2fr"
  )
)
```

`shad_stack()` is the one-dimensional version — a column by default, a row when
asked, with `align`, `justify`, `wrap` and `fill`:

```{r}
demo(
  columns = TRUE,
  shad_stack(
    shad_button("Save"),
    shad_button("Cancel", variant = "outline"),
    shad_button("Delete", variant = "destructive"),
    direction = "horizontal", gap = 2, wrap = TRUE
  )
)
```

## Page shells

*A shadshiny addition: no shadcn/ui counterpart.*

Two wrappers assemble a whole page in one call, taking the `page_shad()`
theming arguments and wrapping content in a `shad_container()` unless you pass
`container = FALSE`.

```r
# a title bar carrying a tab strip; input$nav is the active view
ui <- shad_page_navbar(
  shad_tab("overview", "Overview", overview_ui),
  shad_tab("reports",  "Reports",  reports_ui),
  title = "Acme", inputId = "nav",
  header_end = bslib::input_dark_mode()
)

# the application frame: collapsible sidebar, bar with its trigger, scrolling main
ui <- shad_page_sidebar(
  sidebar = shad_sidebar(
    shad_sidebar_group("Platform",
      shad_sidebar_item("home", "Home", icon = "home", active = TRUE))),
  inputId = "shell", title = "Acme",
  shad_grid(kpi_one, kpi_two, min_width = "14rem")
)
```

The two differ in what scrolls. The navbar shell lets the window scroll and pins
its bar with `position: sticky`; the sidebar shell takes the viewport height and
scrolls its main region instead, because a sidebar that scrolls away is a
sidebar with a drifting rail and footer.

## Sidebar layout

The full app shell: a collapsible sidebar with grouped, badged nav items and a
main region. `input$id` reports `{collapsed, mobileOpen, active}` — observe
`input$id$active` for the selected item.

In a Shiny app you observe `input$demo_shell$active` and swap the main pane
server-side. This static preview does the same thing client-side (listening for
the sidebar's `shad:change` event) so you can see navigation work — **click
Home, Inbox, Search, Settings.**

```{r}
demo(
  columns = TRUE,
  tags$div(style = "height:18rem;border-radius:var(--shad-radius-lg);overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--shad-border)",
    shad_sidebar_layout(
      "demo_shell",
      sidebar = shad_sidebar(
        header = tags$div(style = "display:flex;gap:0.5rem;align-items:center;padding:0.25rem",
          shad_icon("terminal"), tags$strong("Acme")),
        shad_sidebar_group("Platform",
          shad_sidebar_item("home", "Home", icon = "home", active = TRUE),
          shad_sidebar_item("inbox", "Inbox", icon = "mail", badge = "3"),
          shad_sidebar_item("search", "Search", icon = "search")),
        shad_sidebar_group("Account",
          shad_sidebar_item("settings", "Settings", icon = "settings"))
      ),
      main = tags$div(style = "padding:1rem",
        tags$div(style = "display:flex;gap:0.5rem;align-items:center;margin-bottom:0.75rem",
          shad_sidebar_trigger(),
          shad_h4("Home", style = "margin:0", `data-shell-title` = NA)),
        tags$div(`data-panel` = "home",
          shad_p("Dashboard overview. Toggle the sidebar with the trigger; resize the window to see it collapse to a rail.")),
        tags$div(`data-panel` = "inbox", hidden = NA,
          shad_item_group(
            shad_item(title = "Welcome to Acme", description = "2 min ago",
                      media = "mail", media_variant = "icon"),
            shad_item(title = "Your invoice is ready", description = "1 hour ago",
                      media = "file", media_variant = "icon"))),
        tags$div(`data-panel` = "search", hidden = NA,
          shad_empty(title = "Search", description = "Type to search across Acme.",
                     media = "search", media_variant = "icon")),
        tags$div(`data-panel` = "settings", hidden = NA,
          shad_switch("demo_notify", label = "Email notifications", value = TRUE),
          shad_switch("demo_beta", label = "Beta features")),
        # Client-side content switch, standing in for the server observer.
        tags$script(htmltools::HTML("(function(){
          var root = document.getElementById('demo_shell'); if(!root) return;
          var names = {home:'Home', inbox:'Inbox', search:'Search', settings:'Settings'};
          function show(a){
            root.querySelectorAll('[data-panel]').forEach(function(p){
              p.hidden = p.getAttribute('data-panel') !== a; });
            var t = root.querySelector('[data-shell-title]');
            if(t) t.textContent = names[a] || a;
          }
          root.addEventListener('shad:change', function(e){
            var v = e.detail && e.detail.value; if(v && v.active) show(v.active); });
        })();")))
    )
  )
)
```
